details: The crypto market saw a significant boost following news of a ceasefire extension in the Middle East, propelling Bitcoin above $78,000. This rapid price movement triggered nearly $500 million in liquidations across leveraged positions.
title: Bitcoin Surges Above $78K Amid Mideast Ceasefire, $500M Liquidations

details: The New York Attorney General has initiated lawsuits against prominent cryptocurrency exchanges Coinbase and Gemini, alleging they are operating illegal prediction markets. This action signals increased regulatory scrutiny on such platforms.
title: NY Sues Coinbase & Gemini Over Prediction Markets

details: Volo Protocol, a liquid staking platform operating on the Sui network, experienced a security breach that resulted in the loss of approximately $3.5 million from several compromised vaults. The team has since frozen the affected vaults and launched recovery efforts.
title: Sui-Based Volo Protocol Suffers $3.5M Exploit

details: Blockchain Capital, a venture capital firm focused on cryptocurrency investments, is in the process of raising $700 million for two new funds: its seventh early-stage fund and a second growth fund. Some of this capital has already been deployed, indicating continued investor confidence in the crypto space.
title: Blockchain Capital Seeks $700M for Two New Funds

details: Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) for Ethereum have seen a positive trend, recording inflows for nine consecutive days, accumulating an additional $43 million. This sustained interest suggests growing investor confidence in Ethereum-backed investment products.
title: Ether ETFs Extend Inflow Streak to Nine Days with $43M

details: Dan Finlay, a co-founder of MetaMask, a widely used self-custodial cryptocurrency wallet, has announced his departure from Consensys, the company behind MetaMask.
title: MetaMask Co-founder Dan Finlay Departs Consensys

details: Crypto billionaire Justin Sun has filed a lawsuit against World Liberty Financial, a crypto project co-founded by Donald Trump, alleging extortion and an "illegal scheme" to seize his WLFI tokens. Sun had invested $45 million in the project.
title: Justin Sun Sues Trump-Linked Crypto Project Over Frozen Tokens
